notes.title: NEW GAME + DEMO + KICKSTARTER
notes.notes:
WE HAVE A NEW GAME FOY YOU!

You can now try The Whispering Valley for free! You simply have to download the demo on the store page! The demo will still be available after #SteamNextFest. Please take a moment to add this game in your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1512390/The_Whispering_Valley/

We have another surprise!

The Kickstarter campaign is underway. Our goal is to fundraise 26 000$ CAD to finance the rest of the development. The campaign will end on July 17th. We will keep you posted!

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/studiochiendor/the-whispering-valley

You can follow the main creator of this game on Twitter!
https://twitter.com/Olivier_Leclair
